Change: Seed Harvester now takes 500 energy to use.

Manaball Gauntlets now remove 600 VIT instead of 300.
Homunculus spawn removed from Stonehaven.
Fix: Prop pixel offsets now remain across reboots more consistently.
Fixed Seed Harvester having inconsistent energy costs across tooltip and spell.
Fixed Seed Harvester not consuming energy.

Change: Added /seekingrp (alias /lookinglist) which lists all active /L4RPs.
Removed Herobrine.
Aetius spawn removed. Gorgons added to wilderness spawn.

Change: Briarwood can now refuel cooking pots.
Fix: Mirrorwalking portals are now visible.

Fix - Nature: Red vines are no longer immortal.
Fix - Love: Charm should no longer charm you when you BEAT the resist roll.

Change: Ignite and Netzach's Cresent Moon can only hit a maximum of 6 ticks on one target. This means that more than 2 full AOEs hitting a target has no effect.
Ignite damage 3 -> 3.25.
Whirling Dervish is 25% quieter.
Fix: Fixed transceivers not updating their owners when taken from a downed player.
Click TP granted by auras now work as intended.
Say EXP no longer grants EXP while on cooldown. Cooldown reduced from 30 seconds to 10.

Change: Magical beasts now gain quest EXP if they are inside a settlement when it is turned in.

Fix: Fixed defaced descriptors not saving across reboots.
Scarecrows now pay attention to players in boats.
Resource hotspots now have visual representations of the items they spawn again.
Fixed the Justice tarot card using The Chariot's icon.

Change - Druid: Combat form now gives +5% AP instead of 30 POW.

Addition: Capture rolls now show when players are affected by Destined and Sorcerer's Domain.
Fix: Brewing kits will now properly load in sealed.
Fix typo in True Counter spell description.
Fix typo in Scarecrow/Descriptor defacing message.
Fixed some issues with tactical battles concluding.
Invocation of Truth now makes speech default to whitetext.
In-settlement buildings can no longer be built partially outside of settlement bounds.

Addition: Added beans to the game. Find bean seeds in the same place you find other seeds.
Added a text shortcut for guild chat: 'g[index]:' (e.g. 'g1:'). Indexes start at 1. You can see the ordering of your guilds by pressing the "Say" button below the chat window.
Added all existing channel shortcut commands to the 'diamond' chat tab, below the chat commands list.
Change: L4RP status now saves across sessions.
You can now include the [[hide]] in your L4RP message to skip the OOC message.
Fix: Eternal Bond's rings now let you equip and use them.
Eternal Bond's rings now are set to the correct people.

Charm now forces the target to make a charisma saving throw instead of the caster.
Fix: NPCs can now be damaged again.

Eternal Bond - Declare the union of two in a sacred ceremony. Forges custom wedding rings that allows them to track one another's location. 7 day CD.
Change: Food made through the "cooking" tab will now be considered ultra quality. The energy given is unchanged.
Fix: Death now scales off Ether instead of Bio.

Change: Age DR now starts at 30 instead of 25 years.
Restore Vigor now adds 10 years to a character's lifespan. Its cost has been reduced to 75 faith from 150.

Change - Map: After decades of Arcadia development and establishment, its immediate undergrounds are now fully cleansed from the occult influence left by Nythjem. An underground grove has been sprouting, thanks to the efforts provided with the local clergy of Harmony, the Rootkeepers of Verdion, and its inhabitants and allies who participated at the effort.
Change: Faeorum Arcana now has a 30 second cooldown.

Fix: Starting an RPB under the effects of an invisibility potion will now remove its effect.
Removing a potion effect early will no longer cause its effects to unapply twice.
Corrected a message that stated Master of Coin required 300k instead of 500k.
Corrected a lot of daily/weekly quest messages to be more accuate.

Change: Levitation potions no longer give +5 AGI/Crit and are no longer considered "combat" potions.

Fix: Teaching holy magic no longer costs negative faith.
Brewing kits now properly cost 100 wood.
Brewing kits retain their fermentation end time on server restart.
Addition: Bourbon can now be brewed in brewing kits with corn.

Fix: Dead bodies can now be picked up.

Change: Purgatives can now be stacked.
Fix: Anti-magic restraints and remotes no longer break from being placed inside chests before a reboot.
Shimmering Javelin's blue buff effect now extends the duration of the stun instead of shortening it.

Change: True Face's injury now lasts 168 hours instead of 1176.
Fix: Fixed a very, very long-standing bug where light and gravity didn't scale off of metaphyiscal power.
Mapping keys such as shift+1 didn't work due to it trying to map to shift+! and the sort by mistake.
When mapping the last hotbar slot, the text on the button wasn't updating.
Injury names and descriptions can no longer bleed into other things (if you find places where it still does, bug report it, thanks). If you ended up with malformed HTML, ticket for a correction.

Change: Self Heal cannot work on injuries that have been inflicted within the last 3 hours.

Players can now only have 50 VIT, 120 POW, and 10 Elepow/Eledef (per element, not including parent element for subelements) from items, cumulatively. E.g. if you would have 130 POW from a sword and chestplate, it will be clamped at 120 when both are equipped.
/oelements and /delements have been updated to more accurately represent the damage modifiers for a player. For example, having 1 Firepow will show up as 1% fire, magma, plasma, and explosion damage.
Fix: Various props that saved with extra data (namely bookshelves) were having their extra data wiped out when something was placed in the same building after reboots.
Purchasing mount skins no longer consumes all available rush tokens.
Fixed some minor sprite alignment issues with the "Naegling" sword sprite.
You can no longer drop undroppable items by shift-clicking them.
Addition: Admins now have the ability to search the book database and create books from the matches, allowing them to recreate books long thought lost.

Added a recipe for a "purgative", a simple concoction originally created to assist with food poisoning. It additionally allows for the purging of neutral or positive potion effects. Find it in the cooking tab.
Change: Drugs and Combat potions are now exclusive. One cannot be taken while you are under the effect of another.
Violet Veil can no longer perm you on the first use. Chance of perm beyond the first is slightly higher.
Violet Veil, Gold Rush, and Fantasia +POW increased from 25 to 30. Violet Veil +AGI increased from 25 to 30. Drug stacking -VIT multiplier increased from -15 to -17.5.

Addition: Pressing shift while using the face left/right binds will rotate you clockwise and counterclockwise respectively.
Change: Violet Veil, Gold Rush, and Fantasia +POW reduced from 30 to 25. Violet Veil +AGI reduced from 30 to 25. Violet Veil, Gold Rush, and Fantasia energy reduction reduced from 50% to 40%.
Injury names, telepathy, and descriptions allowed HTML adjusted.
Fix: Newlines in injury descriptions weren't being properly converted into line breaks.
Fixed fake ages not being respected.
Potion effects now display the correct remaining duration. Their actual length has not been changed.
Any potion effects held before February 12th will be automatically added to your potion effects on the next rejoin.
/bonus will now state the correct EXP/RPP bonus multiplier.

Change: Players can now have multiple potions in effect at once. All potions have a category (visible on examine or through /potions), and a player can only have 1 potion from a category enabled at once. The exception to this rule are drugs, which can be stacked at a scaling -VIT penalty.

Change - Unarmed: Assassin's Fist: Way of The Shadows AP increase reduced from 30% to 10%.
Change - Earth: Supreme Earth Slide damage increased from 14 to 18.

Fix: Improved the handling of letters for offline players.
Fixed Plaguelands being inaccessable without purchasing Skeleton Uprising and being an undead.
Chronos will no longer set cooldowns to infinite duration.

Fixed certain cases of disguise ages not changing the user's age tag.
Fixed a rare case where Link Transposition could send the caster to nullspace.
Scarecrows now prevent placement of other people's scarecrows.

Summons regenerate all health at the start of each RPB round.

Blood Siphon damage changed from 5.5 to 7.

Master Staff no longer can have gun sprites.

Change: Equipping a disguise now hides your last say/RP from before equipping the disguise. This does not enable private mode.

Fix: Apartment warpers placed against dense walls should now be usable after reboots.

Change: Profile view range increased from 20 to 50.

Fix: Elemental bonuses will no longer disappear on alcohol/food

Change: Merchants no longer sell Krausmas gifts and hats.
Higher quality ingredients give 5x more bonus energy in brewing.
Fix: Brewing kits now dump the correct amount of donus material when being poured out.
Raised undead now will spawn at the location of their necromancer.
You can now gain influence while in apartments.
Ghosted admins no longer appear with Hunter's Eyes.
Fixes non-target glitch with Broken Perspective Strike.
Change - Gorgon: Serpentine Embrace now has a 20 second cooldown.
Change - Water: Water Dome's lowered from 13 to 11, duration decreased from 15s to 10s.
Change - Physical: Adds an anti-requirement to Armed and Unarmed, thus separating them like Moses split the red sea.

Fix: Fixed "Upgrade Undead" giving misleading messages when upgrading, made consistent.

Addition: Spawns added for Sanctuary, Stonehaven, Kindlehelm, and Fortune.
Change: Updated spawns for Arcadia, Caethir, and Aetius.
Fix: Allows you to hear your own thoughts. Fixes repetition.

Change: The further you are from a telepathy user the less chance to have to pick up their thoughts (10% per tile)
Violet Veil's duration increased to 48 hours from 24. Spellpower/AGI increased to 30.
Fix: Herbology ingredients are no longer stackable (again).
Fixed item stacking not functioning.

Addition: Elemental bonuses from food and drink now show up on the tooltip.

Fix: The Brewing Kit now properly lets you delete/adjust it.
Stacking the same type of item but with differing values works better now.
Druid spells can no longer be refunded.

Addition: Adds brewery barrel as a construction prop. You can place up to 50 base ingredients (must be the same type) and a bonus ingredient for every 5 base ingredients.
Change: Sugar Caps recipe now transfers quality to the resulting sugar, and the recipe energy is reduced in half (200 -> 100)
Fix: Wood now fuels a cooking pot for 15 minutes instead of 150.
Corrected the mana stat tooltip to reflect the conversion of mana to DR.

Addition: Adds Krausmas Gift & Krausmas Hat to the merchant. Merry Christmas All!
Change: Compost bins now tell you their maintenance level when checking their status.
Compost bins and chickens are now affected by scarecrows.
Fix: Sin auras now no longer disappear on OOM or being downed.
Sloth sin aura now uses its proper color.
" ", ', and " now auto-punctuate as expected.

Addition: DMs can now use the "Spell Database" verb to create custom tactical spells for events.

Fix: Druid wildshapes will restore your original icon on logout.
Druid wildshape offsets will no longer apply to characters after they return to their original form.

Addition: Added a "Tactical DM" verb for DMs and admins that contains a set of new tactical combat tools for use in events.

Fix: You can now move to escape grabs again.
You can no longer set grabbed people down on dense tiles.
UltraSMASH now benefits from physical power.
Re-fixed auto-punctuation.
Non-owners of boats can now view details, knock, and break in.
Ghosted admins can now right click to examine people again.

Planeshift and Celestial Ascension now can have their actives used while having an aura equipped.

Change: Druids now once again use Vitae instead of essence. Anyone with the druid class will have their essence and spent essence automatically converted to Vitae and spent Vitae.
Every ingredient of the same type you add to a cooking pot/oven loses 25% more vitality and energy added to the dish.
The backend of cooldowns has been partially rewritten. This will likely fix some behavior. If anything seems to not be working as intended, please make a bug report.
Study Creature now reduces the energy regen of its target by 50% instead of increasing all energy costs by 50%.

Fixed a bug where the camera would sometimes continue to follow the person who grabbed you after being dropped.

Nova Ray now properly has its damage increased by Limit Break.
Water Dome and Flood no longer interact strangely with each other.

Sailboats and encampments now have working locks.

Change: Ice Age cooldown 90s -> 45s. It also no longer roots the user on-cast.
Being searched now always displays a message to the target.
Fix: Blood Whip now applies rot every time on-hit.
Characters with pixel offsets (like magical beasts) will no longer have their offsets removed when exiting boats.

Change: Druids now use essence instead of vitae. All vitae is now converted into essence.

Fix: You can no longer pay negative rent.
Faction influence is now displayed as a whole number in most places. Your actual influence is unchanged.
Fixed a bug where dropping an item with a stack count of 1 into a cooking pot doesn't display correctly.
Archdruid stealth wildshape now properly hides your equipment and face.
Removal: Removed the "Challenge" button in the settings menu, as it has been superceded by the "battle" button on the hotbar.

Change: You can no longer waste manaflush potions if you are over level 230.
The probability to gain bonus ore from mining skill now increases beyond level 20.
The delay to mine an ore chunk is now reduced for every 10 levels of mining the player has, with an extra reduction at 100.

Addition - Druid: Adds Bear, Tiger, Crow, Rabbit, and Ent options to Wildshape.
Addition: Adds Flying Broomstick as a mount skin.

Replaces the UI click sounds.

The "buff spells" admin button now properly works for element_off and element_def.
The rules button on the sidebar no longer goes to a dead link.

Added extra FAQ questions to the information page of the grimoire.
